```{r}
source("R/packages.R")
source("R/functions.R")
set.seed(2026)

tar_load(pbp_raw)
```

```{r}
# Subset to all 4th down plays and add some useful annotations
 pbp_clean <- pbp_raw %>%
    filter(
        down == 4,
        play_type %in% c("run", "pass", "field_goal", "punt"),
        !is.na(posteam),
        !is.na(yardline_100),
        !is.na(ydstogo),
        !is.na(game_seconds_remaining),
        !is.na(score_differential)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        is_go = play_type %in% c("run", "pass"),
        is_conversion = case_when(
          is_go & !is.na(first_down) ~ first_down == 1,
          is_go & !is.na(yards_gained) ~ yards_gained >= ydstogo,
          TRUE ~ NA
        ),
        fg_attempt = play_type == "field_goal",
        fg_made = field_goal_result == "made",
        punt_attempt = play_type == "punt"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        decision = case_when(
        play_type %in% c("run", "pass") ~ "Go for it",
        play_type == "punt" ~ "Punt",
        play_type == "field_goal" ~ "Field goal",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        go_for_it = decision == "Go for it",
        ydstogo_capped = pmin(ydstogo, 15),
        yardline_bucket = floor(yardline_100 / 5) * 5
    )
```

## Distribution of 4th Down Decisions

```{r}
pbp_clean %>%
    count(decision) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(decision, n), y = n)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
        title = "Observed 4th Down Decisions",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Plays (N)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
```

## Go-for-it Rates

```{r}
go_rates <- pbp_clean %>%
  group_by(yardline_bucket, ydstogo_capped) %>%
  summarise(
    go_rate = mean(go_for_it, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 25)

go_rates %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = yardline_bucket, y = ydstogo_capped, fill = go_rate)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "darkgreen",
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "NFL Go-for-It Rate on 4th Down",
    subtitle = "By field position and yards to go",
    x = "Yards from Opponent End Zone",
    y = "Yards to Go",
    fill = "Go Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

## Decision Map

```{r}
decision_map <- pbp_clean %>%
  group_by(yardline_bucket, ydstogo_capped, decision) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(yardline_bucket, ydstogo_capped) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) %>%
  slice_max(pct, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(decision_map, aes(x = yardline_bucket, y = ydstogo_capped, fill = decision)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Most Common 4th Down Decision",
    subtitle = "By field position and yards to go",
    x = "Yards from opponent end zone",
    y = "Yards to go",
    fill = "Decision"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Conversion Probabilities

```{r}
fourth_go <- pbp_clean %>%
  filter(
    down == 4,
    play_type %in% c("run", "pass"),
    !is.na(ydstogo),
    !is.na(yards_gained),
    !is.na(yardline_100)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    converted = yards_gained >= ydstogo
  )

conversion_rates <- fourth_go %>%
  group_by(yardline_bucket, ydstogo_capped) %>%
  summarise(
    conversion_rate = mean(converted),
    attempts = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(attempts >= 20)

conversion_rates %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = yardline_bucket,
           y = ydstogo_capped,
           fill = conversion_rate)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "darkgreen",
    labels = scales::percent_format()
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(conversion_rate, accuracy = 1)),
          size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "4th Down Conversion Probability",
    subtitle = "Run/Pass attempts only",
    x = "Yards from opponent end zone",
    y = "Yards to go",
    fill = "Conversion rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Team Aggression

### Full Cohort

```{r}
league_model <- glm(
  is_go ~ ydstogo_capped + yardline_bucket,
  data = pbp_clean,
  family = binomial()
)

pbp_clean <- pbp_clean %>%
  mutate(
    expected_go = predict(league_model, type="response")
  )

team_aggression <- pbp_clean %>%
  group_by(posteam) %>%
  summarise(
    actual_go = mean(is_go),
    expected_go = mean(expected_go),
    attempts = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(attempts > 50)
```

```{r}
team_aggression %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = expected_go, y = actual_go)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = attempts), color="darkgreen") +
  geom_text(aes(label = posteam), nudge_y = .002) +
  geom_abline(linetype="dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "NFL 4th Down Aggressiveness by Team",
    subtitle = "Actual vs Expected Go-for-It Rate",
    x = "Expected Go Rate",
    y = "Actual Go Rate",
    size = "Attempts"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Year Over Year

#### Overall

```{r}
league_aggression <- pbp_clean %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarise(
    go_rate = mean(is_go),
    attempts = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

league_aggression %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = season, y = go_rate)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "darkgreen") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "NFL 4th Down Aggression Over Time",
    subtitle = "Percentage of 4th downs where teams go for it",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Go-for-it rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

> NFL teams have become increasingly aggressive on 4th down over the past decade. The league-wide go-for-it rate rose from roughly 12% in 2010 to over 20% by 2024, reflecting broader adoption of analytics-informed decision making.

```{r}
team_aggression <- pbp_clean %>%
  group_by(posteam, season) %>%
  summarise(
    go_rate = mean(is_go),
    attempts = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(attempts >= 20)

team_aggression %>%
  ggplot(aes(season, go_rate, color = posteam)) +
  geom_line(alpha = .7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "NFL Team 4th Down Aggression Over Time",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Go-for-it Rate",
    color = "Team"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


```{r}
ggplot(team_aggression,
       aes(season, go_rate)) +
  #geom_line(color="darkgreen") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~posteam) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Team-Level 4th Down Aggression Over Time",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Go-for-it Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
